reference_role: The owner-supplied third image is the authoritative visual presentation/style reference; it is NOT a replacement model for other characters.

frame_style.tone: premium gothic high-fantasy character-design atlas; painterly/anime-influenced illustration with crisp high-detail fantasy armour, cinematic lighting and controlled magical glow
frame_style.layout: polished multi-panel infographic: prominent original character hero illustration and consistent turnaround/detailed studies; dense but readable information hierarchy
frame_style.branding: Only the AETHERFALL – REALMS COLIDE title on newly produced approved sheets; do not transplant branding from earlier project images.
frame_style.detail: ornate sharp clean panels, fine rim lighting, polished armor/clothing/organic material variation, detailed silhouette and character-specific signature VFX
frame_style.text: high-contrast legible gothic-fantasy headings with clean support copy; clear labeled diagram and icon captions
forbidden_shortcuts: generic grey clay study offered as final illustrated sheet
silhouette, identity, prop or palette homogenization
AI-invented approval, game model, engine run or test evidence

applies_to: support, tank and damage hero sheets
visual planning for weapons, factions, environments and game interfaces where a concept board is appropriate
3D character art direction and review; actual meshes need separate real evidence
content_rules: Use the full sheet presentation language of the third image, not a simplified replacement.
Each hero has its OWN face, silhouette, materials, colors, role, kit and unique prop; Vellaris's bloodshield belongs only to her.
Existing owner-approved designs are locked; variants are proposals until direct owner approval.
For every new design run provide the actual source reference image, asset ID, status, source hash and side-by-side original/candidate art review.
Original concept art is not Blender/Godot gameplay evidence.
enforcement: tools/verify_visual_canon.py + tests/test_visual_canon.py + mandatory owner side-by-side review; code cannot judge actual visual resemblance.
owner_exception_rule: Only explicit owner approval of a versioned style change, with updated SHA pins and source-to-output evidence, can supersede this standard.
